summary: OpenAI's CEO states the company has paused some frontier reinforcement learning training runs to ensure alignment, security and monitoring standards are met for new model capabilities.

mechanisms.reason: A voluntary pause on some frontier RL training temporarily reduces training compute demand, though the post gives no scale or duration.
mechanisms.quote: We have paused some frontier RL training to ensure that we can meet the appropriate alignment, security and monitoring standards for the new level of capabilities in front of us.

practices.reason: The post references internal alignment, security and monitoring standards being applied before resuming training, but describes no transferable method or metric.
practices.quote: to ensure that we can meet the appropriate alignment, security and monitoring standards for the new level of capabilities in front of us

notable_reason: A frontier lab publicly disclosing that it paused training runs over safety readiness is an unusual admission worth tracking even without specifics.
